features.title: Designed to foster teamwork, Sync pods support productive meetings with thoughtful structure and seamless tech integration transforming meetings into idea hubs,
Sync’s circular design brings everyone closer, fostering equal participation and making it perfect for brainstorming or casual conversations
Designed for movement, Sync pods feature an uncluttered top and lightweight build, moving easily across open-plan offices, supporting agile, team-driven layouts.
Tapered metal legs give Sync pods a sleek, modern look while providing durable stability and a minimal footprint in any space.
Designed with soft edge detailing, Sync tables provide a safer, more comfortable surface for collaborative and high-traffic areas.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
